pages.title: Reality Anchor
pages.text: A device that keeps a patch of reality from being edited. It hard-codes the local laws so that no compiler, demon or paradox can rewrite them while it holds. It is heavy and stubborn, and the space around it feels unusually solid.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Once I could edit reality I needed a way to protect it. In the Reality Compiler, a Source Code Fragment wrapped around a Quark Star Core with Psionic Ether made a region whose code was locked.
Made in $(item)Reality Compiler$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Simulation Hypothesis.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Axiomatic Breach Engine, Primordial Charter, Unified Notes I.
